title: Real Numbers: Chapter Introduction
subject: Mathematics
objective: Break 360 down and only primes are left, the same ones whichever way you break it. The Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic, HCF and LCM, and why √2 is irrational.

fill.q: Every composite number can be expressed as a product of ____.
A number that cannot be written as p/q is called ____.

tf.q: The prime factorisation of a number is unique apart from order.

tf.explain: It cannot be written as p/q.

tf.q: HCF × LCM equals the product of two numbers.

tf.explain: A prime has exactly two factors; 1 has only one.

ar.r: Prime factorisation of a composite number is unique.
√2 cannot be written as p/q with integers p, q (q ≠ 0).

num.q: Find the HCF and LCM of 24 and 36 by prime factorisation.
The HCF of two numbers is 9 and their product is 1620. Find their LCM.

short.q: State the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic.
short.solution: Every composite number can be expressed as a product of primes, and this factorisation is unique apart from the order of the prime factors.
